commits.subject: Open Codex thread links inside the TUI (#62332)
commits.reason: Open canonical thread links in the current terminal. Preserve the linked thread and its backend across navigation and binary handoff, including the first request to resume a live conversation.
evidence: The upstream TUI accepts canonical codex://threads/<id> links, walks parent metadata on the current backend, opens archived transcripts read-only and retains draft state on failed navigation. Picker previews carry their original backend.

The fork shares its task-list output between the TUI and the private MCP endpoint. The adaptation carries upstream’s schema version 5 and navigation hint into both active and archived results while keeping current-account filtering.

The transcript checkpoint now carries a pending link and accepts earlier overlays that could not have one. A retained live attachment participates in upstream’s receiver replacement. The focused controls exercise the typed link and its terminal rendering, the old checkpoint shape, and both task surfaces.
commits.revisit: Verify the first model request when a link reopens a saved thread, as well as linked child and archived views, missing-thread draft preservation, mouse capture and an in-flight transcript selection during a signed upgrade.
